body.statement: When \(\mathcal C=\varnothing\), the activation partition has one cell, every authorized trace is empty, and the SUCCESS syntax and rooted C-forest predicate reduce to the Shpitser--Pearl \(\mathrm{ID}\) recursion and hedge syntax, respectively. Any complete resolution of \(\texttt{oeq:global-context-factor-dichotomy}\) must therefore return the ordinary \(Q\)-factor formula exactly when \(\mathrm{ID}\) succeeds and the ordinary hedge exactly when it fails.
body.justification: The no-CSI case anchors every new syntactic object to the classical complete theory.
body.gap: Shpitser and Pearl settle ordinary identification; the reduction ensures that observed-context syntax is conservative rather than an analogue on a new class.
body.consumer: Existing \(Y_0\) ordinary-identification tests become exact regression tests for the new backend.
